授業科目の概要.講義題目: Cross-Cultural Adjustment 1: Intercultural Guide to Academic Life in Japan
授業科目の概要.対象学部等: 共創学部/School of Interdisciplinary Science and Innovation
授業科目の概要.曜日時限: 秋学期 水曜日 ３時限

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: This course is designed to support international students in navigating academic and daily life in Japan with greater confidence, curiosity, and cultural understanding.  Rather than simply adjusting to Japanese norms, students are invited to reflect critically on their own cultural assumptions while developing meaningful insights into Japanese society, education, and everyday life.  Through readings, discussions, observations, and interviews, students will build intercultural competence as active participants in Japanese campus and community life.
